description: Floating Android device monitor with APK drag-and-drop installation
notes: Windows 10/11 x64. Launch ADB Status from the Start menu or run adb-status.
Uses an existing adb.exe when available; otherwise extracts the embedded, verified ADB 37.0.1 runtime without downloading at startup. USB drivers are not included.
Dropping one APK on the floating window installs it on all online ADB devices with install -r. Enable USB debugging and authorize each device first.
Right-click the floating window and quit ADB Status before upgrading or uninstalling.
Window settings and the bundled ADB cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%\adb-status are retained when uninstalling.
